newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve was expected to inject reserves into the banking system on Thursday via overnight system repurchase agreements.
Analysts projected a $4.5 billion to $5.0 billion average daily add need in the new two-week maintenance period, beginning this session.
Federal funds opened above the 5-1/2 percent target rate at 5-13/16 percent and have since moved up to 5-7/8 percent.
Month-end pressures and settlement of last week's two- and five-year Treasury note auctions were said as the main culprits in keeping funds -- which had risen to 7 percent on Wednesday -- tight.
Analysts at MCM MoneyWatch noted that "seasonal increases in currency in circulation and required reserves will be the prinicpal drainers of reserves."
